query: To further assess the physiological relevance of our workflow as well as its ability to quantify drug effects in 3D cell cultures, we treated AMOs from two different cell lines with increasing concentrations of toxins specific for dopaminergic neurons, namely 6-Hydroxy Dopamine (6OHD) and 1-Methyl-4-phenylpyridinium (MPP+) (Reinhardt et al., 2013b; Blum et al., 2001; Simola et al., 2007; Meredith and Rademacher, 2011).
